# forma

> Interactive 3D product customization studio built with React Three Fiber, Next.js, and Zustand.

forma allows users to explore, configure, and inspect high-fidelity 3D models in real-time with exploded views, animated part focusing, component labeling, and material customization.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://forma-config.vercel.app/): Interactive landing page and product showcase.
- [Configurator Studio](https://forma-config.vercel.app/configurator): Real-time 3D product customization workspace with inspector controls.
- [Full Documentation](https://forma-config.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical architecture, components, and state reference.

## Products & Models

- [Apple Watch Ultra 2](https://forma-config.vercel.app/configurator?model=watch): Smartwatch featuring titanium chassis, digital crown, display, band, and sensor backplate.
- [Santa Cruz V10](https://forma-config.vercel.app/configurator?model=mtBike): Downhill mountain bike featuring carbon frame, suspension, disc brakes, and drivetrain assemblies.
- [Fender Stratocaster 1954](https://forma-config.vercel.app/configurator?model=guitar): Classic electric guitar with wood body, maple neck, pickups, and hardware.
- [Mechanical Keyboard](https://forma-config.vercel.app/configurator?model=keyboard): Custom mechanical keyboard with keycaps, switches, chassis, and rotary encoders.

## Features

- [3D Model Visualization](https://forma-config.vercel.app/configurator): Real-time WebGL rendering with PBR materials, contact shadows, and HDR environment lighting.
- [Part Focus & Inspection](https://forma-config.vercel.app/configurator): Smooth camera framing and orbiting per component category (Case, Band, Crown, Display, Back).
- [Exploded Assembly](https://forma-config.vercel.app/configurator): Spatial part separation along predefined axes with interactive 3D HTML labels.
